caption: Is Black Friday the time to buy a racing wheel for a teen's PS5? On our PS5 page, one of three wheels came down: the Fanatec Gran Turismo DD Pro, $800 to $700 at Fanatec's own store, checked Nov 22. The Logitech G923 (about $230) and Thrustmaster T248R (about $300) show no checked drop. These aren't Amazon's prices: the one at checkout is the one that counts. We earn from qualifying purchases. #blackfriday #ps5 #simracing
title: Black Friday: did PS5 racing wheels actually drop? We checked three
